name: Gold

reconstructions.description: The (22 x sqrt(3)) herringbone reconstruction of Au(111).
reconstructions.reference: J. V. Barth et al., Phys. Rev. B 42 (1990) 9307
reconstructions.note: Not implemented in v0.1; the generated Au(111) surface is the unreconstructed 1x1 truncation and is labelled as such.

band_gap_type.source: classification following the band-gap reference cited for this material

work_function.source: H. B. Michaelson, J. Appl. Phys. 48 (1977) 4729

elastic_C11.source: J. R. Neighbours and G. A. Alers, Phys. Rev. 111 (1958) 707

elastic_C12.source: J. R. Neighbours and G. A. Alers, Phys. Rev. 111 (1958) 707

elastic_C44.source: J. R. Neighbours and G. A. Alers, Phys. Rev. 111 (1958) 707

cohesive_energy.source: C. Kittel, Introduction to Solid State Physics, 8th ed.

nearest_neighbour_distance.source: derived from the lattice parameters in this file

lj_epsilon.conditions: 12-6 Lennard-Jones, infinite-range fcc lattice sums: E_coh / 8.6102. LennardJones.from_material rederives epsilon for the cutoff it uses, 0.46047 eV at the default 10 A shifted cutoff, so that the crystal it evaluates has exactly this cohesive energy
lj_epsilon.source: derived from cohesive_energy in this file
lj_epsilon.note: A pair potential cannot reproduce metallic many-body bonding. Use an EAM potential through the LAMMPS adapter for quantitative metal energetics.

lj_sigma.conditions: infinite-range fcc lattice sums: r_nn / 1.09026. LennardJones.from_material rederives sigma for its cutoff, 2.64084 A at the default 10 A shifted cutoff
lj_sigma.source: derived from nearest_neighbour_distance in this file

references: H. B. Michaelson, J. Appl. Phys. 48 (1977) 4729
J. V. Barth, H. Brune, G. Ertl, R. J. Behm, Phys. Rev. B 42 (1990) 9307
provenance_note: Compiled by the Materia project from the cited primary sources. The Lennard-Jones parameters are an Materia-internal fit, explicitly flagged as an approximation unsuitable for quantitative metal energetics.
